name: XMix #0
description:
Songwriter, musical artist, producer, author, Finn Ambers' nostalgic-happy tune 'An0ther Chr1stmas' conjures a quiet Christmas Eve recalling memories of Christmas past. Each edition is uniquely wrapped...

Each of the 365 editions will contain an elemental 'Song' layer. One instrumental arrangement (state) from each of the other seven layers (Brass, Woodwind, Bass, Keys, Bells, Accordion, and TimpnCell) will be randomly pulled into the mix on minting, giving the collector a unique listening AND visual experience...

The cover image artwork is based on a photograph that captured a special moment of Finn's daughters around the Christmas tree. The lyric from the actual song "The fairy lights dance on the tree..." inspired Finn to represent each minted musical state on the cover art with fairy lights in the bottom left-hand quadrant. For example, if Horns is the minted state from the Brass layer, that is represented by one fairy light in the bottom row. If Bassoons is the minted state from the Woodwind layer, five fairy lights will appear in the second row, and so on for each of the seven layers

Two legendary editions: Golden Egg 1 and Golden Egg 2 are distinct from each other in both cover image and musical composition

In November 2022, An0ther Chr1stmas received a 5-star rating and 'Commended' position in the UK Songwriting Contest

Written by Finn Ambers
Vocals, guitars, keyboards, programming and all instruments: Finn Ambers
Production, composed, arranged, mixing and mastering: Finn Ambers
Artwork and photography: Finn Ambers
